question: What is the absolute percent difference between the total federal expenditures reported in February 1938 and January 1939, rounded to the nearest tenths place in millions of dollars?
raw_response:
The percent difference is 165/528 × 100 = 31.25%, which rounds (half-up) to 31.3.

The total federal expenditures:
- February 1938: 528 million
- January 1939: 693 million

Absolute percent difference = |693 − 528| / 528 × 100 = 31.25% → 31.3 (rounded to nearest tenth, half-up).

<FINAL_ANSWER>31.3</FINAL_ANSWER>
